definition: A pack that reaches this style because an ancestor binds it: descent carries it down the lineage without this style asking, whether or not anyone judged it right for this style.
more: Descent delivers more than anyone chose: a single-pen log cabin can receive classical orders, a Gothic pointed-arch pack and an Iberian arcade from its ancestors. A style that finds a delivered pack wrong for it may decline it.
basis: Our wording of the pack schema's cascade delivery and the inheritance layer's account of it. schema/proportion-pack.schema.json, delivery description: "means the lineage cascade delivers it to every descendant of any node that binds it, whether or not anyone judged that right"; docs/inheritance.md: "five classical orders, a Gothic pointed-arch pack, a Mudejar corbel course and an Iberian arcade, all arriving at a single-pen log cabin"; schema/style-node.schema.json, declined_packs description: "Packs that reach this node BY DESCENT and do not belong on it.".
